records.title: KIN
records.address: 999 W Main St, Suite P101, Boise, ID 83702
records.cuisineContext: Seasonal Pacific Northwest prix fixe dining built around storytelling, local farms, and rotating five-week themes.
records.serviceSummary: Reservation-required, multi-course communal dinner with synchronized storytelling and optional pairings.
records.menuSummary: Five-course rotating prix fixe menu with optional pairings; current menu pages publish dishes, suppliers, seating structure, and fees.
records.occasionFit: Immersive special-occasion dinner; adventurous date; visiting-food-lover destination; communal dining experience.
records.hoursSummary: Prix fixe dining operates Wednesday through Saturday. Art Haus Bar is open Wednesday through Saturday from 4 PM to 11 PM, and Ampersand operates Wednesday through Saturday from 5 PM to 11 PM.
records.reservationDetails: Reservations are required for prix fixe dining and are available through the official website, by phone, or through the restaurant’s current OpenTable path. Art Haus Bar does not require reservations; Ampersand accepts small-party reservations.
records.priceDetails: Current standard five-course menu is published at $130 per person; optional alcoholic or nonalcoholic pairing is $40. Saturday Supper Club is published at $99 with an optional $25 pairing. Service and large-party charges are separately disclosed.
records.dietaryDetails: The restaurant states that vegan, celiac, sober-curious, and other accommodations are considered with advance notice. Substitutions may carry additional charges, and some short-run menus may not support every restriction.
records.beverageDetails: Optional alcoholic and nonalcoholic pairings are published. Art Haus Bar offers cocktails, beer, wine, and nonalcoholic drinks; Ampersand creates custom drinks without a fixed menu.
records.groupDetails: Private parties are accepted seven days a week. The tasting room has 28 seats; large parties and buyouts have additional notice and deposit requirements.
records.atmosphereSummary: Small, communal, performance-like dining room where courses and stories unfold together; more participatory than conventional fine dining.
records.practicalNotes: This is not a flexible drop-in dinner. Confirm the active menu, seating time, cancellation window, dietary feasibility, and whether communal seating suits the occasion before booking.
